notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
After close to 2 years of design and development, I've finally released Ashi with 80 puzzles & 10 challenge levels 🌄 ⛩🕯

It feels thrilling & unreal that the game is publicly available. I hope that players will appreciate the gradual pacing and relaxing aesthetic I pushed hard to imprint into this game 😄

If you haven't seen enough gameplay, check out [url=https://imgur.com/a/nZNQyBi] this IMGUR post for a few gifs[/url]

If you feel inclined, I would very much appreciate any love you show Ashi on social media. If you retweet [url=https://twitter.com/nfcellini/status/1015011245743902720] this announcement on Twitter[/url] , or [url=https://www.facebook.com/AshiLakeGame/videos/179059722949768/] share this Facebook post[/url], I would very much appreciate it!

If you aren't already, you can [url=https://www.facebook.com/AshiLakeGame] follow Ashi on Facebook[/url] , or [url=https://twitter.com/nfcellini]me on Twitter for updates[/url].

Finally, if you play Ashi and enjoy anything about it, from the puzzle design, to the music, I would very much appreciate it if you left a review.

Thanks for reading!
Nick ❤️
